claims.text: CVE-2024-3094 is a critical supply-chain vulnerability discovered in XZ Utils versions 5.6.0 and 5.6.1 that alters functions within liblzma targeting OpenSSH server authentication.
The backdoor payload intercepts the RSA key signature verification function RSA_public_decrypt in OpenSSH sshd.
The vulnerability was initially identified by Andres Freund while benchmarking SSH latencies.
CVSS v3.1 Base Score assigned to CVE-2024-3094 is 10.0 (Critical).
Prevention controls include parameterized queries, positive server-side input validation, and context-aware escaping.
CVE-2021-44228 refers to Log4Shell, a remote code execution vulnerability in Apache Log4j2 versions 2.0-beta9 through 2.14.1.
Log4j resolves JNDI URLs by contacting the LDAP server to retrieve and execute remote Java class files.
NIST AC-2(3) specifies automatically disabling inactive accounts after 90 days of operational inactivity.
NIST AC-7 enforces account lockout when 5 consecutive invalid logon attempts occur within a 15-minute window.
The root cause of Heartbleed is missing bounds checking on a TLS heartbeat extension request payload using memcpy.
Threat group UNC2452 executed the SolarWinds SUNBURST attack against Orion platform releases.
SUNBURST remains dormant for up to 14 days before attempting DNS lookups against C2 domains.
SwiftSafe guarantees zero raw pointers in public API, requiring safe wrappers SafeRef or UniquePtr.
TLS 1.3 reduces connection handshake latency from 2-RTT to 1-RTT for full handshakes and 0-RTT for resumption.
TLS 1.3 defines AEAD cipher suites including TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384, and TLS_CHACHA20_POLY1305_SHA256.
